tool.name: notepadpp_new_document
tool.description: Create a new empty untitled document (tab) in the active Notepad++ view by calling Notepad_plus::fileNew() in-process.

resolution.strategy: module base + RVA, guarded by PE TimeDateStamp and entry bytes of fileNew and Notepad_plus_Window::runProc
resolution.calling_convention: win64 thiscall: void fileNew(Notepad_plus* this /* rcx */)
resolution.thread_affinity: GUI thread owning the top-level 'Notepad++' window (via WAM.onUiThread)
resolution.this_or_state_resolution: GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd 'Notepad++', GWLP_USERDATA) = Notepad_plus_Window*; check +0x18 (_hSelf) == hwnd; this = window + 0x20 (_notepad_plus_plus_core, per runProc 'ADD RCX,0x20'); check this[0] (_pPublicInterface) == window, _pDocTab/_pNonDocTab (+0x800/+0x808) point inside the object, _activeView (+0x32fc) in {0,1}

postcondition.why: NPPM_GETNBOPENFILES(ALL_OPEN_FILES) returns _mainDocTab.nbItem()+_subDocTab.nbItem(); fileNew adds exactly one buffer to the current view
TCM_GETITEMCOUNT summed over the tab controls: the new document adds one tab
fileNew switches to the new buffer, so the title becomes 'new N - Notepad++' with a fresh N
